ge.label: SDK 门面；进程内 Session 注册与分派
ge.code:
GEInitialize → GEInitializeV2 / SessionManager::Initialize
Session → ConstructSession → SessionManager::CreateSession
Session::ExecuteGraphWithStreamAsync → GetSession → InnerSession
Session::~Session → DestroySession

ge.label: Session 身份、InnerSession 与资源归属
ge.code:
SessionManager → session_manager_map_[session_id]
InnerSession → GraphManager / ModelExecutor / user graph managers
DestroySession → DestroyRtContexts → InnerSession::Finalize → erase

ge.label: 图注册、构建、装载状态；host-side 运行锁
ge.code:
GraphManager → graph_map_[graph_id] → GraphNode
CompileGraph → PreRun → GeRootModel → SetBuildFlag(true)
LoadGraph → executor::LoadGraph → SetLoadFlag(true)
ExecuteGraphWithStreamAsync → run_mutex / RunFlag → executor

ge.label: model_id 映射与静态/Hybrid 执行分支
ge.code:
ModelExecutor → GeRootModel::model_id
ModelManager → HybridDavinciModel | DavinciModel
DavinciModel::NnExecute → aclmdlRIExecuteAsync

metadef.label: 运行时 Tensor；关键字段投影
buffer 的地址、容量、位置与管理函数
metadef.code:
TensorData = {addr_, manager_, size_, placement_}

TensorData::~TensorData() → Free()
Free() → manager_ == nullptr ? SUCCESS
                            : manager_(addr_, kFreeTensor, nullptr)
